pr_title: Add custom background line colour to TextEdit and remove marked lines
pr_body:
Separating this from my WIP branch as part of #31739

Added a way to set/get the background colour of a line, the background colour is now drawn on the minimap. This supersedes marked lines which have been removed.

During the process I cleaned up some duplicated theme loading code between each of the editors.

closes #34165
closes godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/987

issue_context.title: TextEdit is not exposing a way to highlight specific lines
issue_context.body:
Godot 3.2 beta2

I need to highlight lines in a `TextEdit`, a bit like the script editor does when there is a parsing error. I see it's done using the `set_marked()` function, and that it uses the `marked_line` color which is exposed. However, `set_marked()` is not exposed, so I can't use that in my app... any chance to expose the ability to highlight lines? Or even just have a way to custom-draw them?

review_comments: It's worth noting that `font_color` and `font_color_selected` are the only theme items whose name differs from the matching editor setting (`text_color` and `text_selected_color`). Do we want to harmonize them?

`font_color` is like our default font color property in a lot of controls 🤔 But `text_color` makes more sense for this particular editor setting. I'd keep it.

Though `font_color_selected` should be changed to `font_selected_color` or `selection_font_color`.

Nice catch should been `font_selected_color`.

Yeah `text` sounds better to me, though only for the editor, don't want to make `TextEdit` itself have a different naming scheme to the rest of the controls.
